name: g2-ai-assistant
description: Advanced Claude-powered AI assistant for Even Realities G2 smart glasses (Even Hub), integrated with Gmail, Google Calendar, location and notifications.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @g2/shared && npm run build -w @g2/server && npm run build -w @g2/glasses
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @g2/shared && npm run typecheck -w @g2/server && npm run typecheck -w @g2/glasses
scripts.test: npm run test -w @g2/server && npm run test -w @g2/glasses
